dev-s154a-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Kestrel is a production endpoint, owned by team delta
Dana Okafor (staff id u55806) leads team delta
Lukas Brandt (staff id u61183) is on team delta and leads no team

timeline.text: Change request CR-3369 to disable the classifier for deploy 4066 on Project Kestrel is approved by Lukas Brandt
Incident INC-3293 opens on Project Kestrel; a rollback starts
Deploy 4066 turns the safety classifier off on Project Kestrel (production) during rollback INC-3293
Monitoring shows Project Kestrel serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 4066 turned the classifier off on Project Kestrel, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-3369 was approved by Lukas Brandt, who doesn't lead team delta).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-3369 was approved by someone who leads no team.
